notes: New: OLED guard (under TOOLS, Full and Premium). Leave your PC on without burn-in: after a few minutes with no mouse or keyboard your OLED goes fully black, and any input brings it straight back. Your other screens keep running, and it never kicks in during a fullscreen game or video. It's off until you turn it on
OLED guard can also auto-hide your taskbar and remove the thin bar to the right of the clock
BattleBot Quick attack: F9 now ends the battle and goes home for you, then starts the next one
